EYE READABILITY CORRECTION IS THE MAIN PRIORITY. The eyes in the attached atlas are still tiny and muddy. In EVERY frame replace them with larger, clearly separated bright WHITE almond-shaped eyes, about 25 percent larger white areas while keeping the SAME head size. Each eye contains one SOLID BLACK OVAL pupil about half the eye's vertical opening; no little white glare dots, no gray or blue iris, no black smudge touching the upper lid. Use a clean dark outline with at least one white pixel separating the pupil from the lower eyelid at final sprite size. Match the original second reference's large white eyes and oval black pupils. Preserve the heavy half-lids but open them enough to read both pupils. Do not merely sharpen the same small dark marks. Keep all prior full-body proportions, poses and clothing exactly the same and keep the mouth-SPIT release.

Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, exact eye count, colors, clothing, accessories and slender long torso. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.

IDENTITY: Single BLUE boxing Sproto, swept spiky blue head and broad YELLOW stripe/crest down the right side of the head, red round nose and broad red lips. Exactly TWO crisp WHITE almond-shaped eyes with black oval pupils, dark sharp eyelid outlines, no yellow or blue tint inside the white sclera. Pupils clearly separated from lids and visible at small game size. Large RED boxing gloves with white cuffs, entirely WHITE raised collar, black sleeveless outfit, blue low legs and red/white shoes. Preserve the existing complete-body proportions and clothing. Ranged attack is a mouth SPIT: inhale, cheeks inflate, mouth snaps forward/open and exhales, gloves stay in guard. Preserve the first reference's complete body and clothing. Use the second original reference for the EXACT eye shape and pupil clarity only: retain WHITE collar and RED boxing gloves from the first image. Focus on crisp white eye shapes, clearly visible deep black oval pupils and strong dark outlines in every frame. Eyes should remain readable after downsampling to a 128px-tall fighter; no muddy gray eyes or disappearing pupils.

Exactly 32 full-body figures in a regular 4-column by 8-row grid. Row 1: relaxed combat guard; subtle exhale guard; forward guarded step with near foot leading; weight passes over near planted foot.
Row 2: forward guarded step with far foot leading; weight passes over far planted foot; forward dash with low lean and both legs anatomically connected; jump anticipation with hips lowered and knees bent.
Row 3: rising jump with both low-rooted knees gathered; falling jump with legs extending for landing; low crouched landing with both soles grounded; light punch anticipation with shoulder and elbow coiling.
Row 4: fully extended straight punch toward the right; punch retracting to guard; uppercut low-body coil; clear rising uppercut with elbow then fist high, two legs retained.
Row 5: side kick chamber, near knee lifted from LOW hip, support foot planted; half-extended kick with knee opening; fully extended waist-height side kick, low hip, ankle and toes aligned; kick knee retracts before planting.
Row 6: low sweeping kick with one grounded bent support leg; sweep recovery returning over the low pelvis; airborne kick chamber with both legs originating at lower body; airborne kick full extension with coherent second leg folded.
Row 7: recoiling from a chest hit, head and torso remain joined; solid two-arm high guard; reaching forward to catch with clearly visible open hand; close grab hold with both arms bent toward an imagined opponent but NO opponent drawn.
Row 8: forward throw release with planted feet, no opponent; SPIT windup, head leans back slightly, cheeks inflate, lips purse, gloves remain raised near chest; SPIT release, head leans forward with open red mouth and forceful exhale, gloves remain near chest, NO projectile or miniature character drawn; broad triumphant team special impact stance.
